## Your data

- **No telemetry, analytics or crash uploads.** MDX doesn't collect anything about you or your documents.
- **No network connections.** This version never connects to the internet.
- **No account.** Nothing to sign up for.
- **Local storage only.** Tabs, favourites and recent files are saved in `%APPDATA%\getaxtools\MDX` on your PC.

Check a download: compare its SHA-256 hash with `SHA256SUMS.txt`, or verify its build provenance with `gh attestation verify <file> --repo getaxtools/MDX`.
